name: guard-rails
description: Safety rails on Bash. DENIES: uncapped file dumps into context (points at Read/Grep), a re-dump of a file already in context, git commits missing the Claude trailers, --amend on pushed history, a second unpushed commit on a branch. ASKS before: force-push, reset --hard, git clean -f, branch delete, stash drop, worktree remove, two-dot diffs against a base. Nudges on comment-heavy edits. Silent on everything else.
